plugin.name: Need for Speed: The Run Fusion Fix
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skip startup videos and login prompts.
MAIN.ImproveWindowedMode.description: Make windowed mode borderless and match the selected resolution.
CAMERA.Enable.description: Enable mouse and right-stick look for the chase camera. Unbind conflicting right-stick controls in the game.
CAMERA.CameraReturnTimeout.description: Seconds without camera input before returning behind the car.
CAMERA.CameraReturnSpeed.description: How quickly the camera returns behind the car.
Allow only horizontal right-stick look when the stick also controls gear changes.
CAMERA.CollisionOffset.description: Distance kept between the camera and an obstacle.
CAMERA.MinCamDistance.description: Minimum camera distance when avoiding obstacles.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Limit race frame rate. Zero uses the game limit; turn off game VSync to exceed the display refresh rate.
FRAMERATE.UnlockFrameRate.description: Use the game VSync setting outside load screens instead of forcing 30 FPS. Requires game version 1.1.
FRAMERATE.UnlockCutscenes.description: Unlock cutscenes and quick-time events with smooth character updates. Requires Unlock Frame Rate.
FRAMERATE.SmoothReflections.description: Update car reflections every rendered frame.
GRAPHICS.ConsoleGamma.description: Use a stronger contrast curve with deeper colors.
GRAPHICS.MinimapFix.description: Restore road segments missing from the minimap.
GRAPHICS.AnisotropicFiltering.descriptio: Minimum anisotropic filtering. Zero keeps the game setting.
GRAPHICS.ShadowResolution.description: Shadow map size. Zero keeps the game setting; applies after restart and level load.
GRAPHICS.ShadowDistance.description: Maximum shadow draw distance. Zero keeps the game setting; applies after restart and level load.
UNLOCKS.UnlockAllCars.description: Make all vehicles available in the garage.
MISC.RightStickDeadzone.description: Ignore small right-stick movements during camera look.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Multiply the field of view in races. Cutscenes keep their own.
